changelog: Templates are now Find → Actions: one find plus a list of actions (click, key, scroll, drag, wait, move) edited on the card, several images in FIND, and Held for on every template. Stop now always stops (no clicks after Stop, the hotkey works from any app in Hybrid), no crash on quick Play/Stop, drags hold long enough to pick items up, and GPU window capture (WGC) finally ships, so capture keeps working when the game is covered.
